examples.en: I baked a birthday cake.

examples.sr: Ово је мој [ро̏ђенда̄нскӣ] поклон за тебе.
examples.en: This is my birthday present for you.
I drink tea with a cookie.
Kids love chocolate cookies.

tips: Кекс is a cookie or biscuit, not a cake: једем кекс уз чај.

examples.en: I haven't been getting enough sleep lately.
That salary isn't enough to live on.
The key got stuck in the lock.
I got stuck on the third question.
The voivode led the army into battle.
He lives like some kind of duke.
He can't take criticism.
The film got good reviews.
The service in that hotel is excellent.
They used to have servants in the house.
Breakfast is paid for separately.
I need to double-check it.
I walk to work.
It's ten minutes to the center on foot.

tips: «Пешице» is an equally correct variant: «Идемо пешице».

examples.en: They have five children.
Five people were sitting at the table.

note: Used with «деца» and mixed groups; for men only, петорица.

examples.en: She was born in January.
It's always cold at the beginning of January.
I spread jam on bread.
Grandma makes plum jam.
The press wrote a lot about it.
The book is already being printed.
I went to bed early last night.
Lie down for a bit and rest.

note: «лећи» - to lie down, «лежати» - to be lying

examples.en: Prices have risen significantly.
He gave me a meaningful look.
The company's headquarters is in Belgrade.

examples.sr: Јавите се [цѐнтрали], они ће вас повезати.
examples.en: Call the switchboard, they'll put you through.
The ship sailed into the bay.
We swam in a small bay.
I walked her to the station.

examples.sr: Дошли су да нас [ѝспрате̄] на аеродром.
examples.en: They came to see us off at the airport.
Whatever you do, I'll support you.
If you need anything, let me know.
We have to change our tactics.
That's his old tactic.
Payment is cash only.
This is solely your fault.
He gave a thumbs-up to show approval.
I hit my thumb with a hammer.

note: Only the thumb; a finger in general is «прст».
tips: Serbs count fingers starting with the thumb, so it is "one". The 👍 gesture can therefore mean "one" rather than "great". Pl. палчеви.

examples.en: The glass is half full.
Everything is half price at the sale.
The superhero wears a red cape.
She came out of the bathroom in a bathrobe.
Firefighters are rescuing people from the building.
Who is saving whom here?
The car braked sharply.
The temperature dropped suddenly.
Plastic waste pollutes the sea.
The old car ended up in a junkyard.
Jealousy ruined his marriage.
It's just ordinary jealousy.

tips: Љубомора is only a noun, with the adjective љубоморан; there is no verb. To be jealous is бити љубоморан. It also covers envy: љубоморни на комшије.

examples.en: We visited the Petrovaradin Fortress.
The fortress was built in the Middle Ages.
The house burned to the ground.
I got sunburned on the very first day.
Pay the full amount by the end of the month.
What is the amount of the bill?
Who pays for shipping the goods?
Public transportation in the city isn't bad.
Ana and Marko are engaged.
She has been engaged for a year already.

note: Not to be confused with «веран» - faithful

examples.en: A strong wind is blowing outside.
Blow out the candles!
Life is slowly returning to normal.
Your blood pressure is normal.
We keep old things in the attic.
He went up to the attic to get a suitcase.
He left the waiter a big tip.
Is the tip included?
I saw it on the net.
I don't have internet on my phone.
I need a stamp on this document.
The letter bore the state seal.
There are iron ore deposits in these mountains.
Miners dig for ore deep underground.
The country declared independence.
She values her independence.
We're going on a picnic on Sunday.
We brought food for the picnic.
Hit the brake!
The brakes don't work!
We need to process this data.
The farmer worked the field before the rain.

tips: «Обрадити тему» - to cover a topic, go through it in class: «Професор је обрадио нову лекцију». Not to be confused with «обрадовати» - to make happy.

examples.en: It's extremely hot today.
This is extremely dangerous.
He got a promotion at work.
We are working on improving our services.
He has chronic fatigue syndrome.
That's classic middle child syndrome.
Grandpa had a heart attack last year.
I almost had a heart attack!
According to folk belief, that brings good luck.
I respect your beliefs.
That station broadcasts on a different frequency.
Traffic volume has increased.
You are prejudiced against him.
We must fight prejudice.
I feel lonely in the new city.
The house stands alone on a hill.
He had a stroke last year.
Brain activity is normal.

examples.sr: [Тр̀ча̄ње] ујутру ме буди боље од кафе.
examples.en: A morning run wakes me up better than coffee.
He has been running for ten years.
She hung the laundry out on the balcony.
The traitor was hanged in the square.

note: For clothes on a hook, «окачити» is more usual.

examples.en: Is there a discount for students?
I got a twenty percent discount.

related.en: to give in; to ease off

tips: «Имате ли попуст?» - Do you have a discount? Also common: «акција» (a sale) and «снижење» (a price reduction).

examples.en: I'm taking my dog to the vet.
The vet examined the cat.
The painting was sold at an auction.
They put the house up for auction.
He kissed her on the cheek.
That man has no shame.

tips: Not only «cheek»: «образ» also means honor and dignity. «Имати образа» - to be decent, «немати образа» - to have no shame, «чист образ» - a clean reputation.
«Спасити образ» - to save face, «без образа» - shameless.

examples.en: Dad is fixing the car in the yard.
He is always correcting my grammar.
He is an Orthodox Christian.
Christians celebrate Christmas.
From now on I'll arrive on time.
From now on there are no more secrets between us.

note: «одсад па надаље» - from now on and onward

examples.en: Grandpa smokes a pipe in the evening.

examples.sr: Запалио је [лу̏лу] и сео у фотељу.
examples.en: He lit his pipe and sat down in the armchair.
There is a statue of the king in the square.
He stood motionless as a statue.
He works as a researcher at an institute.
Researchers have discovered a new drug.
The city lies east of the river.

examples.sr: Село је тридесет километара [ѝсточно] од Београда.
examples.en: The village is thirty kilometers east of Belgrade.

note: Used with од + gen.: источно од града

examples.en: Welcome, Your Excellency.
His Excellency the ambassador arrives tomorrow.
The children are feeding the fish in the aquarium.
The goldfish grants three wishes.
He commanded a platoon of soldiers.
The power line was damaged in the storm.
Describe to me exactly what you saw.
This watch keeps very accurate time.
He lost all his money in the casino.
They go to the casino on Saturdays.
You're still too young for that.
She was too young to get married.

forms: збива се, збивају се; pf. збити се

examples.en: What's going on here?
The film is set in Paris.
We have a three-day supply of water.
The player started the match on the bench.
Do you have a spare key?
The spare tire is in the trunk.
It's understandable that you're angry.
He explained everything clearly and comprehensibly.
The customs officer checked the contents of the bag.
The content of the book is more interesting than its title.
There's an intruder in the house!

examples.sr: Осећам се као [у̏љез] на овој забави.
examples.en: I feel like an outsider at this party.

tips: In kids' puzzles «Пронађи уљеза» means "find the odd one out". The word itself also means an uninvited guest or an outsider.
«Синдром уљеза» or «синдром варалице» - impostor syndrome: the feeling that you don't deserve your success and will be found out.

examples.en: It was a clear, starry night.
That was his shining moment.
From now on we work together.
We will continue to keep you informed.
I love classical music.
That's a classic example of bad organization.
Can I get your autograph?
He collects footballers' autographs.
We worked eight hours without a break.
After a short break the broadcast continues.
I'm offering you a deal.
We reached a deal with the prosecutor.
The rules apply to everyone, without exception.
The exception proves the rule.
He was arrested for obstructing the investigation.
Sorry for the interruption.
He was buried with the highest honors.

examples.sr: Била ми је [по̏ча̄ст] да вас упознам.
examples.en: It was an honor to meet you.
The rescue operation lasts all day.
Thank you for saving me!
Ironically, he was the one who won.
He smiled ironically.
She is a loyal fan of our club.
She was a cheerleader in high school.
The quality of service is excellent.
I'd rather pay more for quality.
The police are working on capturing the killer.
Catching fish with your hands isn't easy.
The results are astonishing.
Her eyes are a stunning blue.
Mom was a housewife all her life.
The hostess served us cakes.
Mom forbids me to stay out late.
The law prohibits smoking in cafes.
I desperately need coffee.
You look terrible, what's wrong?
He treated her cruelly.
That was cruel of you.
Buy me a bag of chips.
Don't eat chips before dinner.
He's a real psychopath.
The police are looking for the psychopath who escaped.
Careful, that's acid!
I have excess stomach acid.

examples.sr: Стави пиво у фрижидер да се [охла̀ди].
examples.en: Put the beer in the fridge to chill.
Go outside for a bit to cool off.
The general hospital is in the city center.
That's common knowledge.
What a wonderful day!
You have a lovely garden.
He became an orphan at the age of five.
They adopted an orphan from the orphanage.

note: Neuter, even for a person: то сироче

examples.en: That brat broke my window!
What an ill-mannered brat you are!
I've been on a diet since Monday.
The doctor put him on a strict diet.
After the victory the celebration began.
The festivities lasted until dawn.
His story sounds truthful.
Answer all the questions truthfully.
That experience was humiliating.
They put him in a humiliating position.

examples.sr: Добио је [стипѐндију] за студије у иностранству.
examples.en: He received a scholarship to study abroad.
I live on my stipend.
My late grandfather was a carpenter.
This is a picture of my late grandmother.
See you the day after tomorrow.

examples.sr: Испит је [преко̀сутра], а ја ништа не знам.
examples.en: The exam is the day after tomorrow, and I don't know anything.
I had a nightmare last night.
This trip is a real nightmare.
Let's meet by the monument in the square.
They erected a monument to the poet.

examples.sr: Сви морамо заједно да се боримо против [теро̀ризма].
examples.en: We all have to fight terrorism together.
He was charged with terrorism.
The police set off in pursuit.
After a long chase they caught him.
I only have a thousand-dinar note.
This bill is fake.

examples.sr: Не љути се, то је само [зе̏за̄ње].
examples.en: Don't be mad, it's just a joke.
Enough fooling around!

tips: Зезање also means fun, a good time or a joke: «Биће лудо зезање» (it'll be a blast), «Нема зезања» (no kidding).

examples.en: He has no authority with the children.
He is an authority in his field.
Dozens of people were waiting in front of the building.
Several dozen fans were arrested.
The lawyer asked for a postponement of the trial.
No more delays!
He fell and broke two ribs.
I ordered roasted pork ribs.
Put the lid on the pot.
I can't unscrew the lid of the jar.
The policeman demanded a bribe.
Taking bribes is a criminal offense.

examples.sr: То не мора [ну̏жно] да значи нешто лоше.
examples.en: That doesn't necessarily mean something bad.
You don't have to come tomorrow.

note: Bookish; in speech «потребно, неопходно» are more common
tips: «Нужно» - necessary, required: «није нужно да идеш» (you don't have to go), «нужно зло» (a necessary evil), «нужна помоћ» (urgent help). Also «не значи нужно» - doesn't necessarily mean.

examples.en: Children ride a pony in the park.
She always wanted a white pony.
They trained the dog to sniff out drugs.
The soldiers are well trained.

note: Not to be confused with «обући» - to dress

examples.en: He cites an example from practice.
What leads you to that thought?

examples.sr: За доручак сам јео јаја са [сла̀нином].
examples.en: For breakfast I had eggs with bacon.
Buy two hundred grams of bacon.
She has an artistic soul.
That's a true work of art.
He gave me the flu.
The wound is infected, you need an antibiotic.
Everything went smoothly.
He shaved clean before the wedding.
He is the league's top scorer.
The gunman fired from the roof.
Read the letter aloud.
I didn't mean to say it out loud.
That's how it goes in life.
Everything is getting worse and worse.
There is a statue of a poet in the park.
She stood motionless as a statue.
After the breakup she was sad for a long time.
We are seeking termination of the contract.
The painter painted her portrait.
A portrait of my grandfather hangs on the wall.
Voting starts at seven in the morning.
He didn't turn up to vote.
The apartment has been completely renovated.
I completely forgot!
Take out the trash, please.
He presented his opinion at the meeting.
Write your name here.
My daughter enrolled in medical school.

note: уписати факултет - to enroll in a university

examples.en: I got a three in math.
Take the number 3 to the center.

note: School grades go from 1 to 5; «тројка» is satisfactory

examples.sr: Какав [та̑јминг]! Баш сам хтео да те зовем.
examples.en: What timing! I was just about to call you.
Your timing is terrible.
Grandpa has a workshop in the basement.
I signed up for a painting workshop.
Slow down before the bend!

examples.sr: Пут кроз планину има много оштрих [кривѝна].
examples.en: The mountain road has many sharp bends.
Be more careful in the future.
In the future we will let you know sooner.
I learned a thing or two about it.
Bring something to eat.
Fasten your seat belts, we are starting our descent.
The landing was smooth.
Now we're even.

examples.sr: Врати ми сто динара и [кви̑т] смо.
examples.en: Give me back a hundred dinars and we're even.
I've lived here for a decade already.
A lot has changed over the last few decades.
He answered me very sharply.
Turn sharply left!
The internet lets us work from home.
The scholarship enables him to study abroad.

tips: A typical advertising verb: омогућава makes something possible, followed by «да»: омогућава да видите.

examples.en: Enter the code and press OK.
Bring the chairs in, it's raining.
Everyone dived into the food.

examples.sr: Немој да [нава̀лиш] на њега са питањима.
examples.en: Don't pile on him with questions.
We don't negotiate with terrorists.
They are negotiating a new contract.
My wrist hurts.
He dislocated a joint during training.
I'm for it, but he is against.
But if he doesn't come after all, we'll go alone.

note: Bookish; not to be confused with «опет» - again

examples.en: Don't act silly.
I look silly in this hat.
We have to postpone the meeting.
Put down the gun!
You have no authority to do that.

examples.sr: Дао сам му [овлашће́ње] да потпише уговор.
examples.en: I gave him authorization to sign the contract.

forms: растанем се, растану се; impf. растајати се

examples.en: We parted as friends.

examples.sr: Тешко ми је да се [раста̀нем] од тебе.
examples.en: It's hard for me to part from you.
An unknown aircraft was spotted over the city.
A drone is filming the terrain.
For the slava we roast a piglet.
You're as dirty as a pig!
My car is at the repair shop.
The service in this restaurant is slow.
February is the shortest month.
We'll be back at the beginning of February.
Vitamin C boosts immunity.
A diplomat has immunity.
The captain lifted the trophy.
He keeps his trophies in a display case.
He is a federal agent.
Federal law prohibits this.
He studies philosophy in Belgrade.
My philosophy is simple: enjoy yourself.

examples.sr: Не зна да скува јаје, а [ка̏моли] ручак.
examples.en: He can't boil an egg, let alone cook lunch.

examples.sr: Нема пара за хлеб, а [ка̏моли] за ауто.
examples.en: He has no money for bread, let alone for a car.

note: After a negative: «а камоли» - let alone

examples.en: He dragged the old wardrobe up from the basement.
Who dragged you here?
The phone has a two-year warranty.
There's no guarantee that he'll succeed.
Farmers blockaded the road.

examples.sr: Имам потпуну [блока̀ду], не могу да пишем.
examples.en: I have a complete block, I can't write.
It's a rare genetic disease.
The genetic test confirmed paternity.
I got a flat on my bicycle wheel.
The suitcase has four wheels.

tips: After the numbers 2-4 the form is точка: «четири точка»; otherwise the plural is точкови.
A wheel is «точак» (pl. точкови). The word «кола» means a car, not wheels.

examples.en: Everyone came except Marko.
We work every day except Sunday.

examples.sr: Живимо у новом [на̀сељу] на крају града.
examples.en: We live in a new neighborhood on the edge of town.
It's a small settlement by the river.
Do you want fries with your burger?
I ordered a large order of fries.
I like to listen to jazz in the evening.
They play jazz at the club every Friday.
I want to atone for my sins.

examples.sr: Покушава да се [иску̀пи] за оно што је урадио.
examples.en: He is trying to make up for what he did.

examples.sr: Ово је копија, а где је [оригѝна̄л]?
examples.en: This is a copy, where is the original?
I watch films in the original, with subtitles.
A civil war broke out in the country.
The civil wedding is on Saturday.
He had a nervous breakdown.
The company is on the verge of collapse.
Stress is bad for the nervous system.
After the divorce she had a nervous breakdown.

note: About the nerves; a nervous person is «нервозан»

examples.en: We're looking for cheap accommodation by the sea.
The price includes accommodation and breakfast.
He claims he was arrested illegally.
The company illegally fired the workers.

examples.sr: Направи ми сендвич са [шу̏нком] и сиром.
examples.en: Make me a sandwich with ham and cheese.
I bought two hundred grams of ham.
There is dirt everywhere in the apartment.
Clean the dirt off your shoes.

note: Mud or slush in the street is «блато»

examples.en: He has been boxing since he was little.
Last night we watched boxing until late.
I've been learning Italian for a year.
I love Italian cuisine.
Wrap a scarf around your neck, it's cold.
Grandma knitted me a wool scarf.

note: A scarf, not a shawl (that is «марама»)

examples.en: I don't approve of your behavior.
Her father doesn't approve of her relationship.
He stood at the very edge of the abyss.
She was on the verge of tears.
The mountains look majestic.
The opening was magnificent!

examples.sr: Као дете сам хтео да будем [астрона̀ут].
examples.en: As a child I wanted to be an astronaut.
The astronauts returned to Earth.
That's too risky.
He drives recklessly even in the rain.
We vacationed at the seaside as a family.
We celebrate with just family, in a small circle.
The squirrel jumps from branch to branch.
We fed the squirrels in the park.
The fence is made of iron.
You need more iron in your diet.

tips: «Старо гвожђе» - scrap metal. «Нисам за старо гвожђе» - I'm not ready for the scrap heap yet.
